title: enform instance.cancelled@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.cancelled@1 event (S13, WF-4, AC-1, AC-5, I2, I4, I14). A principal that holds instance.cancel on the flow cancels an instance with a required reason, so the event names the instance, the step that the close ended, the holder it notified when it had one, the reason, and the notification to that holder in the same operation (I2, SE-5). The event is a marker on the append-only log; the undo is a separate instance.undone@1 event and never rewrites this one (I4).

instanceId.description: The id of the instance that the cancellation acts on (DX-1).

step.description: The step whose open task the cancellation closed (WF-4).

holder.description: The principal that held the closed task (AS-2); absent when nobody had claimed it.

reason.description: The reason the cancelling principal gave, which is required (MVP.md 5.6, S13).

outbox.description: The side effects that the cancellation causes, committed with the state change (I2, SE-5).

outboxEntry.description: One side effect (SE-1): the connector operation, the connector, and its payload.
